3610907602.detail_text: Skin's wet dream. Makeup worst nightmare. Oil and water for twice the impact with this dual-phases liquid makeup removers that delicately dissolves away even the most stubborn waterproof mascaras and longwearing lip colours. This gentle yet effective formula soothes skin and seamlessly takes off high-performance MAC products designed to stay on. Just shake, then saturate a cotton pad to remove eye and lip makeup in a quick and easy swipe - then rinse your face with cool water for a cleansed complexion. Suitable for all skin types and ideal for intense looks, this non-irritating formula does not cause acne or clog pores as it restores your complexion to a fresh, bare-faced canvas.

product.desc:
What is it:

Our iconic lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a silky matte finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels better and lasts longer. Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in our widest range of [40] Artist-appoved shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a creamy blend of coconut oil, organic shea butter and organic cocoa butter that conditions and nourishes lips. Get MORE CARE with instant and eight-hour moisture. Get MORE LONGWEAR with 12 hours of non-fading, long-lasting colour that leaves lips looking visibly fuller from the very first ultra-vibrant glide. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside. And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a lipstick case featuring at least 30% PCR material. The iconic matte Lipstick that changed the world we live in may have been reimagined, but each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will…).

Benefits:

•Conditions and nourishes lips

•Immediate and 8-hour moisture

•Comfortable formula

•Lips look visibly fuller, 12 hours

•Longwearing and colour-true, 12 hours

•Non-feathering and non-bleeding, 12 hours

•Non-flaking and non-caking, 12 hours

APPLICATION:

•Apply Lipstick directly to lips.

•Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish.

•Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour.

REMOVAL:

•Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips.

•Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry. "

detail_blocks.text: What is it: Our iconic lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a silky matte finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels better and lasts longer. Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in our widest range of [40] Artist-appoved shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a creamy blend of coconut oil, organic shea butter and organic cocoa butter that conditions and nourishes lips. Get MORE CARE with instant and eight-hour moisture. Get MORE LONGWEAR with 12 hours of non-fading, long-lasting colour that leaves lips looking visibly fuller from the very first ultra-vibrant glide. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside. And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a lipstick case featuring at least 30% PCR material. The iconic matte Lipstick that changed the world we live in may have been reimagined, but each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will…). Benefits: •Conditions and nourishes lips •Immediate and 8-hour moisture •Comfortable formula •Lips look visibly fuller, 12 hours •Longwearing and colour-true, 12 hours •Non-feathering and non-bleeding, 12 hours •Non-flaking and non-caking, 12 hours APPLICATION: •Apply Lipstick directly to lips. •Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish. •Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour. REMOVAL: •Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips. •Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry. "

product.desc:
What is it:

Our iconic lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a silky matte finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels better and lasts longer. Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in our widest range of [40] Artist-appoved shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a creamy blend of coconut oil, organic shea butter and organic cocoa butter that conditions and nourishes lips. Get MORE CARE with instant and eight-hour moisture. Get MORE LONGWEAR with 12 hours of non-fading, long-lasting colour that leaves lips looking visibly fuller from the very first ultra-vibrant glide. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside. And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a lipstick case featuring at least 30% PCR material. The iconic matte Lipstick that changed the world we live in may have been reimagined, but each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will…).

Benefits:

•Conditions and nourishes lips

•Immediate and 8-hour moisture

•Comfortable formula

•Lips look visibly fuller, 12 hours

•Longwearing and colour-true, 12 hours

•Non-feathering and non-bleeding, 12 hours

•Non-flaking and non-caking, 12 hours

APPLICATION:

•Apply Lipstick directly to lips.

•Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish.

•Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour.

REMOVAL:

•Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips.

•Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry. "

13707936790.title: MAC Skinfinish Colourstruck Blush | Blurring Powder Blush, 12HR Colour-True Wear, Matte and Radiant Finishes
13707936790.detail_text: Cheeks look striking with this velvety, blurring powder blush that provides buildable and blendable coverage with 12HR colour-true wear*. Available in natural matte and radiant finishes, this Artist-curated lineup comes in a wide range of [29] iconic and lip-inspired shades, including Velvet Teddy, Candy Yum-Yum and Thanks, It’s M·A·C!. Formulated to provide fantastic colour payoff to face and cheeks, this highly pigmented innovation blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly over makeup with a silky texture and weightless feel for soft-focus to mega-bold blush looks. Pop into the centre of cheeks to keep it classic, blend across the bridge of nose for a sun-kissed effect, apply to undereyes and upper cheeks for a youthful flush or sweep along temples in a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour. Suitable for sensitive skin with a non-acnegenic , non-comedogenic and non-drying formula. Key Claims and Benefits •Velvety blurring powder blush •12HR colour-true wear •Natural matte and radiant finishes •Medium buildable coverage •Blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly •Silky texture and weightless feel •Water-resistant •Non-drying •Dermatologist-tested, suitable for sensitive skin •Non-acnegenic and non-comedogenic (does not cause acne or clog pores) How to Use •Tap off excess powder and use a 129S Brush to apply blush to the desired areas of the face using sweeping strokes. •Blend well and build to your perfect level of intensity. PRO BLUSH PLACEMENTS: •Pop into the apples of cheeks for a classic look. •Blend across the bridge of nose for a seamless, sun-kissed effect. •Apply to undereye areas and upper cheekbones for a youthful, soft-focus flush. •Sweep along temples using a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour.

product.desc:
Cheeks look striking with this velvety, blurring powder blush that provides buildable and blendable coverage with 12HR colour-true wear*. Available in natural matte and radiant finishes, this Artist-curated lineup comes in a wide range of [29] iconic and lip-inspired shades, including Velvet Teddy, Candy Yum-Yum and Thanks, It’s M·A·C!. Formulated to provide fantastic colour payoff to face and cheeks, this highly pigmented innovation blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly over makeup with a silky texture and weightless feel for soft-focus to mega-bold blush looks. Pop into the centre of cheeks to keep it classic, blend across the bridge of nose for a sun-kissed effect, apply to undereyes and upper cheeks for a youthful flush or sweep along temples in a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour. Suitable for sensitive skin with a non-acnegenic , non-comedogenic and non-drying formula.

Key Claims and Benefits

•Velvety blurring powder blush

•12HR colour-true wear

•Natural matte and radiant finishes

•Medium buildable coverage

•Blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly

•Silky texture and weightless feel

•Water-resistant

•Non-drying

•Dermatologist-tested, suitable for sensitive skin

•Non-acnegenic and non-comedogenic (does not cause acne or clog pores)

How to Use

•Tap off excess powder and use a 129S Brush to apply blush to the desired areas of the face using sweeping strokes.

•Blend well and build to your perfect level of intensity.

PRO BLUSH PLACEMENTS:

•Pop into the apples of cheeks for a classic look.

•Blend across the bridge of nose for a seamless, sun-kissed effect.

•Apply to undereye areas and upper cheekbones for a youthful, soft-focus flush.

•Sweep along temples using a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour.

page_json.name: MAC Skinfinish Colourstruck Blush | Blurring Powder Blush, 12HR Colour-True Wear, Matte and Radiant Finishes
page_json.description: A velvety blurring powder blush that provides buildable, blendable coverage and 12HR colour-true wear* in matte and radiant finishes.  Cheeks look striking with this velvety, blurring powder blush that provides buildable and blendable coverage with 12HR colour-true wear*.  Available in natural matte and radiant finishes, this Artist-curated lineup comes in a wide range of [29] iconic and lip-inspired shades, including Velvet Teddy, Candy Yum-Yum and Thanks, It’s M·A·C!. Formulated to provide fantastic colour payoff to face and cheeks, this highly pigmented innovation blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly over makeup with a silky texture and weightless feel for soft-focus to mega-bold blush looks. Pop into the centre of cheeks to keep it classic, blend across the bridge of nose for a sun-kissed effect, apply to undereyes and upper cheeks for a youthful flush or sweep along temples in a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour. Suitable for sensitive skin with a non-acnegenic , non-comedogenic and non-drying formula.Key Claims and Benefits•Velvety blurring powder blush •12HR colour-true wear•Natural matte and radiant finishes•Medium buildable coverage •Blends effortlessly and layers seamlessly•Silky texture and weightless feel •Water-resistant•Non-drying•Dermatologist-tested, suitable for sensitive skin •Non-acnegenic and non-comedogenic (does not cause acne or clog pores)How to Use•Tap off excess powder and use a 129S Brush to apply blush to the desired areas of the face using sweeping strokes. •Blend well and build to your perfect level of intensity.  PRO BLUSH PLACEMENTS:•Pop into the apples of cheeks for a classic look.•Blend across the bridge of nose for a seamless, sun-kissed effect.•Apply to undereye areas and upper cheekbones for a youthful, soft-focus flush. •Sweep along temples using a C shape to wrap eyes in on-trend colour.

product.desc:
FULL DESCRIPTION

A one-step powder and foundation that gives skin a smooth, flawless, all-matte finish with medium-to-full coverage and a velvety texture that allows skin to breathe. Long-wearing, colour-true, non-caking, non-streaking, non-settling/creasing, non-fading – all for 12 hours. Available in a wide range of colours.

KEY CLAIMS AND BENEFITS

• 12 hour wear

• Immediately reduces appearance of pores

• Controls oil and shine, 8 hours

• Non-drying

• For all skin types, especially oily skin

• Stay-true colour, 12 hours

• Non-acnegenic

• Non-streaking/caking/settling, 12 hours

• Sweat- and humidity-resistant

• Photo-friendly

USAGE

Apply to a well moisturized and prepped skin with a fluffy brush like the 129SH or 109 for lighter coverage. Apply with the sponge applicator for more coverage. If you use the sponge, make sure to replace your sponge every few weeks and store it in the compartment underneath the powder and not in the top compartment with the powder. Try finishing your Studio Fix application with a light veil of Prep + Prime Fix+ to give it a fresh skin like appearance!

3169888374.title: MAC Macximal Sleek Satin Lipstick sleek satin finish 8HR hydration pigment rich colour
3169888374.detail_text: What is it: Our signature Satin Lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a Sleek Satin finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels creamier, glides smoother and hydrates lips for eight whole hours. Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in an Artist-approved range of 34 personality-packed shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a balmy blend of good-for-lips ingredients, including pomegranate flower extract to hydrate lips and camellia seed and rosehip oils to condition. Get MORE SLEEK with this undupeable lineup of meticulously crafted colours that provides a pristinely polished look on lips. Get MORE CHIC with this multiuse formula that serves up a seamless, monochromatic gleam on cheeks. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside. And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a Lipstick case that features PCR material. Each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will). Benefits: •8 hours of comfort and hydration •Hydrates lips with pomegranate flower extract •Conditions lips with camellia seed and rosehip oils •Full-coverage, pigment-rich colour •Works on lips and cheeks •Lips look visibly fuller and more defined •Plumps lips via moisturization •Visibly reduces the appearance of fine, dry lines •Signature vanilla scent •Lipstick case features PCR material Application: •Create a smooth canvas for colour with Prep + Prime Lip. •Apply Lipstick directly to lips. •Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish. •Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour. •Pro tip: Apply to the centre of lips and blend out using a 318S Brush to create a blurred effect. Removal: •Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips. •Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
3169888374.detail_html:
What is it:

Our signature Satin Lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a Sleek Satin finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels creamier, glides smoother and hydrates lips for eight whole hours. 

Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in an Artist-approved range of 34 personality-packed shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a balmy blend of good-for-lips ingredients, including pomegranate flower extract to hydrate lips and camellia seed and rosehip oils to condition.

Get MORE SLEEK with this undupeable lineup of meticulously crafted colours that provides a pristinely polished look on lips. Get MORE CHIC with this multiuse formula that serves up a seamless, monochromatic gleam on cheeks. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside.

And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a Lipstick case that features PCR material. Each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will).

Benefits:

•8 hours of comfort and hydration 

•Hydrates lips with pomegranate flower extract

•Conditions lips with camellia seed and rosehip oils

•Full-coverage, pigment-rich colour

•Works on lips and cheeks

•Lips look visibly fuller and more defined

 •Plumps lips via moisturization

•Visibly reduces the appearance of fine, dry lines 

•Signature vanilla scent

•Lipstick case features PCR material

Application:

•Create a smooth canvas for colour with Prep + Prime Lip.

•Apply Lipstick directly to lips.

•Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish.

•Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour.

•Pro tip: Apply to the centre of lips and blend out using a 318S Brush to create a blurred effect.

Removal:

•Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips.  

•Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

product.desc:
What is it:

Our signature Satin Lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a Sleek Satin finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels creamier, glides smoother and hydrates lips for eight whole hours. 

Get MORE COLOUR with full-coverage, pigment-rich payoff in an Artist-approved range of 34 personality-packed shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a balmy blend of good-for-lips ingredients, including pomegranate flower extract to hydrate lips and camellia seed and rosehip oils to condition.

Get MORE SLEEK with this undupeable lineup of meticulously crafted colours that provides a pristinely polished look on lips. Get MORE CHIC with this multiuse formula that serves up a seamless, monochromatic gleam on cheeks. Get a MORE LUXE look with a high-shine packaging design on the outside and M·A·C-embossed bullet on the inside.

And finally, get MORE RESPONSIBLE with a Lipstick case that features PCR material. Each famous and fresh hue still serves up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will).

Benefits:

•8 hours of comfort and hydration 

•Hydrates lips with pomegranate flower extract

•Conditions lips with camellia seed and rosehip oils

•Full-coverage, pigment-rich colour

•Works on lips and cheeks

•Lips look visibly fuller and more defined

 •Plumps lips via moisturization

•Visibly reduces the appearance of fine, dry lines 

•Signature vanilla scent

•Lipstick case features PCR material

Application:

•Create a smooth canvas for colour with Prep + Prime Lip.

•Apply Lipstick directly to lips.

•Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish.

•Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour.

•Pro tip: Apply to the centre of lips and blend out using a 318S Brush to create a blurred effect.

Removal:

•Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips.  

•Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

3063009319.title: 【20% SAVINGS】MAC Fix+ Setting Spray 100ml Duo Set (worth $108) / Alcohol-Free, Hydrates
3063009319.detail_text: What it is: Our ultimate multitasker is a visionary in its versatility: Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets, refreshes makeup – and so much more. The fan-favourite setting spray you know and love now comes with a fine-mist pump to adore! Use this Artist-approved overachiever in even more innovative ways to power up pigments, erase makeup errors, sheer out foundation, etc. This alcohol-free formula features good-for-skin ingredients, including vitamins and minerals, along with green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts. Product Benefits: •Primes •Sets makeup •Improves the quality of makeup wear for up to 12 hours •Keeps makeup looking fresh for up to 12 hours •Immediately moisturizes skin •Instantly soothes skin via hydration •Delivers an all-over hydrating glow •Suitable for all skin types •Does not cause acne or clog pores •Alcohol-free Product Usage: •Use before, during or after makeup. •With eyes and mouth completely closed, mist face evenly while holding bottle 12 inches away from face. •For face products, apply your favourite powder foundation and lightly mist all over face to set and hydrate. •For colour products, apply your favourite eye shadow or pigment to your preferred brush, lightly mist bristles and sweep across lids for an intensified shadow look.
3063009319.detail_html:
What it is:

Our ultimate multitasker is a visionary in its versatility: Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets, refreshes makeup – and so much more. The fan-favourite setting spray you know and love now comes with a fine-mist pump to adore! Use this Artist-approved overachiever in even more innovative ways to power up pigments, erase makeup errors, sheer out foundation, etc. This alcohol-free formula features good-for-skin ingredients, including vitamins and minerals, along with green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts.

Product Benefits:

•Primes

•Sets makeup

•Improves the quality of makeup wear for up to 12 hours

•Keeps makeup looking fresh for up to 12 hours

•Immediately moisturizes skin

•Instantly soothes skin via hydration

•Delivers an all-over hydrating glow

•Suitable for all skin types

•Does not cause acne or clog pores

•Alcohol-free

Product Usage:

•Use before, during or after makeup.

•With eyes and mouth completely closed, mist face evenly while holding bottle 12 inches away from face.

•For face products, apply your favourite powder foundation and lightly mist all over face to set and hydrate.

•For colour products, apply your favourite eye shadow or pigment to your preferred brush, lightly mist bristles and sweep across lids for an intensified shadow look.

product.desc:
What it is:

Our ultimate multitasker is a visionary in its versatility: Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets, refreshes makeup – and so much more. The fan-favourite setting spray you know and love now comes with a fine-mist pump to adore! Use this Artist-approved overachiever in even more innovative ways to power up pigments, erase makeup errors, sheer out foundation, etc. This alcohol-free formula features good-for-skin ingredients, including vitamins and minerals, along with green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts.

Product Benefits:

•Primes

•Sets makeup

•Improves the quality of makeup wear for up to 12 hours

•Keeps makeup looking fresh for up to 12 hours

•Immediately moisturizes skin

•Instantly soothes skin via hydration

•Delivers an all-over hydrating glow

•Suitable for all skin types

•Does not cause acne or clog pores

•Alcohol-free

Product Usage:

•Use before, during or after makeup.

•With eyes and mouth completely closed, mist face evenly while holding bottle 12 inches away from face.

•For face products, apply your favourite powder foundation and lightly mist all over face to set and hydrate.

•For colour products, apply your favourite eye shadow or pigment to your preferred brush, lightly mist bristles and sweep across lids for an intensified shadow look.

1244428966.detail_text: Add a painterly touch to eye liner application. Brushstroke Liner features a precision brush tip that makes liquid lining sharp, fast and easy. This mistake-proof, tapered-tip pen creates the perfect line – thick or thin – in one sweep. For the finest line, use the brush tip; for a bolder one, try the brush’s flat side. Smudge-proof and budge-resistant, this liner offers superior, intense colour in black or brown that wears strong all day long, yet removes with just warm water. Add a painterly touch to eye liner application. Brushstroke Liner features a precision brush tip that makes liquid lining sharp, fast and easy. This mistake-proof, tapered-tip pen creates the perfect line – thick or thin – in one sweep. For the finest line, use the brush tip; for a bolder one, try the brush’s flat side. Smudge-proof and budge-resistant, this liner offers superior, intense colour in black or brown that wears strong all day long, yet removes with just warm water.

KEY CLAIMS AND BENEFITS

Long-wearing, 24 hours

Features easy and precise lining

Features rich, intense colour

Smudge-proof

Transfer-resistant

Water-resistant

Sweat- and humidity-proof

Ophthalmologist tested

Safe for contact lens wearers

Removes easily with warm water

USAGE

Apply directly to lash line.

3128057281.title: MAC Fix+ Alcohol Free Multitasking Setting Spray 100ml hydrates primes sets and refreshes makeup ​
3128057281.detail_text: What it is: Our ultimate multitasker is a visionary in its versatility: Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets, refreshes makeup – and so much more. The fan-favourite setting spray you know and love now comes with a fine-mist pump to adore! Use this Artist-approved overachiever in even more innovative ways to power up pigments, erase makeup errors, sheer out foundation, etc. This alcohol-free formula features good-for-skin ingredients, including vitamins and minerals, along with green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts. Product Benefits: •Primes •Sets makeup •Improves the quality of makeup wear for up to 12 hours •Keeps makeup looking fresh for up to 12 hours •Immediately moisturizes skin •Instantly soothes skin via hydration •Delivers an all-over hydrating glow •Suitable for all skin types •Does not cause acne or clog pores •Alcohol-free Product Usage: •Use before, during or after makeup. •With eyes and mouth completely closed, mist face evenly while holding bottle 12 inches away from face. •For face products, apply your favourite powder foundation and lightly mist all over face to set and hydrate. •For colour products, apply your favourite eye shadow or pigment to your preferred brush, lightly mist bristles and sweep across lids for an intensified shadow look.
3128057281.detail_html:
What it is:

Our ultimate multitasker is a visionary in its versatility: Fix+ hydrates, primes, sets, refreshes makeup – and so much more. The fan-favourite setting spray you know and love now comes with a fine-mist pump to adore! Use this Artist-approved overachiever in even more innovative ways to power up pigments, erase makeup errors, sheer out foundation, etc. This alcohol-free formula features good-for-skin ingredients, including vitamins and minerals, along with green tea, chamomile and cucumber extracts.

•Sets makeup

•For colour products, apply your favourite eye shadow or pigment to your preferred brush, lightly mist bristles and sweep across lids for an intensified shadow look.

product.desc:
MINERALIZE SKINFINISH NATURAL

A luxurious, slow-baked domed face powder with low-level pearlized pigments that provide a dimensional yet natural finish. Can be used to set foundation and to touch-up makeup throughout the day. Features our M·A·C Multi-Mineral Complex and vitamin E.

A luxurious, slow-baked, velvety soft, domed face powder with a radiant finish. Strategically buff on to add highlights to the high points of the face, or blend all over for a sheer luminous polish to the skin. Features our M·A·C Multi-Mineral Complex and vitamin E.
product.highlights:
• Provides radiance
  • Features M·A·C Multi-Mineral Complex
  • Dermatologist tested
  • Ophthalmologist tested
  • Non-acnegenic
  • Perfect for contouring face and body
  • For a wide variety of skin tones

3125183900.title: MAC Glow Play Tendertalk Lip Balm / Tinted hydrating lip balm
3125183900.detail_text: What is it: Lip balm doesn’t have to be boring! [10] PH-activated tints hit lips with shiny, shade-shifting colour and 24 hours of moisture*! This comfy, cushiony balm is infused with 91%** naturally derived ingredients, including a nourishing blend of jojoba seed and sunflower oils, along with shea butter for a softer, smoother and more supple look. Plus, it prevents dryness and protects + strengthens the moisture barrier of lips – all while serving up a personalized, playful pop of glowy colour based on the unique chemistry of your pout. Melt it across lips and bounce it across cheeks with your fingertips! This fresh formula is free of the stuff you don’t want, including parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients, and the packaging is crafted using recyclable materials. Benefits: •Strengthens and protects moisture barrier of lips •24-hour moisture* •91% naturally derived ingredients** •Prevents dryness and locks in moisture •PH-activated, shade-shifting colour •Comfortable formula •Free of parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients *Clinical testing on 27 Asian women after using product once. **Using the ISO 16128 Standard from plant, non-petroleum mineral and/or water sources. APPLICATION: • Apply directly to lips or cheeks. Use your fingertips to blend out the colour across cheekbones, temples or the bridge of your nose.
3125183900.detail_html:
What is it:

Lip balm doesn’t have to be boring! [10] PH-activated tints hit lips with shiny, shade-shifting colour and 24 hours of moisture*! This comfy, cushiony balm is infused with 91%** naturally derived ingredients, including a nourishing blend of jojoba seed and sunflower oils, along with shea butter for a softer, smoother and more supple look. Plus, it prevents dryness and protects + strengthens the moisture barrier of lips – all while serving up a personalized, playful pop of glowy colour based on the unique chemistry of your pout. Melt it across lips and bounce it across cheeks with your fingertips! This fresh formula is free of the stuff you don’t want, including parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients, and the packaging is crafted using recyclable materials.

Benefits:

•Strengthens and protects moisture barrier of lips

•24-hour moisture*

•91% naturally derived ingredients**

•Prevents dryness and locks in moisture

•PH-activated, shade-shifting colour

•Comfortable formula

•Free of parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients

*Clinical testing on 27 Asian women after using product once.

**Using the ISO 16128 Standard from plant, non-petroleum mineral and/or water sources.

APPLICATION:

• Apply directly to lips or cheeks. Use your fingertips to blend out the colour across cheekbones, temples or the bridge of your nose.

product.desc:
What is it:

Lip balm doesn’t have to be boring! [10] PH-activated tints hit lips with shiny, shade-shifting colour and 24 hours of moisture*! This comfy, cushiony balm is infused with 91%** naturally derived ingredients, including a nourishing blend of jojoba seed and sunflower oils, along with shea butter for a softer, smoother and more supple look. Plus, it prevents dryness and protects + strengthens the moisture barrier of lips – all while serving up a personalized, playful pop of glowy colour based on the unique chemistry of your pout. Melt it across lips and bounce it across cheeks with your fingertips! This fresh formula is free of the stuff you don’t want, including parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients, and the packaging is crafted using recyclable materials.

Benefits:

•Strengthens and protects moisture barrier of lips

•24-hour moisture*

•91% naturally derived ingredients**

•Prevents dryness and locks in moisture

•PH-activated, shade-shifting colour

•Comfortable formula

•Free of parabens, phthalates and animal-derived ingredients

*Clinical testing on 27 Asian women after using product once.

**Using the ISO 16128 Standard from plant, non-petroleum mineral and/or water sources.

APPLICATION:

• Apply directly to lips or cheeks. Use your fingertips to blend out the colour across cheekbones, temples or the bridge of your nose.

13692430183.title: MAC Multisculpt Matte Liquid Colour | Eye + Face Contour, Cloud-Matte Finish
13692430183.detail_text: Instantly achieve your ideal bone structure from eyeliner to jawline. This 24HR liquid eye and face contour was crafted to effortlessly finetune your features with buildable, blendable colour and a natural cloud-matte finish in a comfortable, lightweight formula. Sculpt multiple ways with your favourite nude shades to create a wide range of softly diffused to seriously defined looks. Line and define cheeks for an angular look or corset cheekbones by carving with cool tones for a hollowed-out effect. Visually life and elongate eyes or emphasize your aegyo sal, by embracing the K-beauty trend that promotes a plumper and fuller undereye look. Shade the sides of your nose from tip to brow bones and highlight the bridge - blending out to softly sculpt - or building up for a bolder contour. Highlight your chin and draw along your jaw to accentuate your natural face shape. Designed for here, there or everywhere - your technique is totally up to you. Plus, this customizable, undetectable - and non-injectable - innovation provides water-, sweat-, humidity- and transfer-resistant wear that won't settle or crease. So why, go under...when you can M·A·C me over? Benefits: •24HR colour-true longwear •Provides buildable and blendable coverage •Natural-looking, cloud-matte finish •Comfortable and lightweight feel •Water-, sweat- and humidity-resistant •Transfer-resistant •Non-settling and non-creasing Product Usage: Apply directly to skin using the applicator, clean fingertips or concealer brush. Blend with fingertips, a sponge or a brush. SOFT SCULPTING FOR DIFFUSED LOOKS EYES: •Apply 2-3 dots directly from the applicator to your eyelids. •Blend with clean fingertips or a 217S Brush. FACE: •Apply 2-3 dots directly from the applicator in the contours of your face and cheeks. •Blend with a 159S Brush. STRONG SCULPTING FOR DEFINED LOOKS EYES: •Use the applicator to apply a light swipe on eyelids and/or creases. •Blend with a 239S Brush. FACE: •Use the applicator to apply a light swipe in the contours of your face and cheeks. •Blend with a 190S Brush.

product.desc:
Instantly achieve your ideal bone structure from eyeliner to jawline. This 24HR liquid eye and face contour was crafted to effortlessly finetune your features with buildable, blendable colour and a natural cloud-matte finish in a comfortable, lightweight formula. Sculpt multiple ways with your favourite nude shades to create a wide range of softly diffused to seriously defined looks. Line and define cheeks for an angular look or corset cheekbones by carving with cool tones for a hollowed-out effect. Visually life and elongate eyes or emphasize your aegyo sal, by embracing the K-beauty trend that promotes a plumper and fuller undereye look. Shade the sides of your nose from tip to brow bones and highlight the bridge - blending out to softly sculpt - or building up for a bolder contour. Highlight your chin and draw along your jaw to accentuate your natural face shape. Designed for here, there or everywhere - your technique is totally up to you. Plus, this customizable, undetectable - and non-injectable - innovation provides water-, sweat-, humidity- and transfer-resistant wear that won't settle or crease. So why, go under...when you can M·A·C me over?

Benefits:

•24HR colour-true longwear

•Provides buildable and blendable coverage

•Natural-looking, cloud-matte finish

•Comfortable and lightweight feel

•Water-, sweat- and humidity-resistant

•Transfer-resistant

•Non-settling and non-creasing

Product Usage:

Apply directly to skin using the applicator, clean fingertips or concealer brush. Blend with fingertips, a sponge or a brush.

SOFT SCULPTING FOR DIFFUSED LOOKS

EYES:

•Apply 2-3 dots directly from the applicator to your eyelids.

•Blend with clean fingertips or a 217S Brush.

FACE:

•Apply 2-3 dots directly from the applicator in the contours of your face and cheeks.

•Blend with a 159S Brush.

STRONG SCULPTING FOR DEFINED LOOKS

EYES:

•Use the applicator to apply a light swipe on eyelids and/or creases.

•Blend with a 239S Brush.

FACE:

•Use the applicator to apply a light swipe in the contours of your face and cheeks.

•Blend with a 190S Brush.

3610935532.title: MAC Hyper Real Skincanvas™ Waterlight Cream HA3 Moisturizer 50ml
3610935532.detail_text: Give skin a water break with this hydration-boosting cream powered by a high-impact trio of Hyaluronic Acids. This weightless formula targets and fight dryness, drenching skin in an undetectable veil of potent skincare ingredients while delivering a petal-smooth finish for a makeup-ready canvas. Formulated with resilient and rare Japanese Peony Extract to even skin tone over time, Niacinamide to minimize the appearance of pores, visibly improve radiance and even skin tone over time, Hyaluronic Acid to lock in moisture and sugar kelp to tighten the appearance of pores, this triple-powered, transformative moisturizer provides hyperhydration for a luminous look at every angle - with or without makeup. This skin-refining formula also visibly reduces the appearance of pores and fine lines for a radiant, healthy-looking glow. 96% had improvement in skin barrier strength after just one use*. Tested on all skin tones. *Clinical testing on 23 panelists after using product once.

Tested on all skin tones.

product.desc:
Get that voluptuous glow from the It-gloss you love – now in six sparkling shades that plump lips with comfort and care in a stick. Each new gloss stick features a pearlescent base laced with non-grainy glitter particles – providing a nourished, polished, plumped-up look in every non-sticky, shimmery glide. Ginger root oil and capsicum extract bring the heat while menthol crystals cool – serving up a subtle tingly sensation that provides instant plumping and visible volume. Coconut oil, shea butter and avocado oil nourish, condition and impart glassy shine. Ready to make lips SQUIRT? Just look for the last name: SPARKS!

Key Claims & Benefits

•Imparts a glassy shine

•Nourishes, conditions and enhances appearance of lips

•Instant plumping and visible volume with subtle tingling sensation

•Leaves lips soft, smooth and healthy looking

WARNING: You may experience a tingle. If uncomfortable, discontinue use. Keep away from children.

How to Use

•Apply onto face or body with a 143S Bronzer Fan Brush for natural-looking warmth and sun-kissed colour.

•Blend or build to desired coverage and look.

product.desc: Whip of a monochromatic, hazy matte look with Powder Kiss Lip + Cheek Mousse. this multi-use liquid mousse provides the perfect blur of 10-hour moisturizing longwear on lips and a comfortable and uniquely spreadable formula that instantly blurs lips and effortlessly enhances your complexion for a natural-looking flush. A special blend of powders and emollients glide on evenly while staying pillowy soft and smooth all day for an ultra-diffused look that's non-creasing and non-drying. Its hourglass-shaped applicator perfectly hugs the curves of your lips to blur lip lines and provides a smoothing effect. 95% deposited the right amount of colour*
product.highlights: • A multi-use hazy matte mousse that provides the perfect blur of 10-hour hydrating longwear on lips and a soft-focus flush of colour on cheeks.

13691349707.title: MAC Studio Fix 24HR Colour Corrector | Liquid Colour Corrector, Targets Skin Concerns
13691349707.detail_text: Balance and build an immaculate base with 24HR colour correctors. This undetectable innovation offers a quick, on-the-spot Fix for an array of skin concerns with a natural, soft-matte finish and 24-hour colour-true longwear. Apply a small dot or a smooth swipe to instantly correct the look of dark spots and undereye circles, visually reduce redness, neutralize undertones, disguise discolouration or give light to dull or grey areas. Each provides comfortable and customizable camouflage with a hydrating formula that doesn’t feel tight or dry. So, whether a pesky pimple popped up overnight or your summer foundation is too warm for winter, this ultra-versatile, lightweight liquid formula is the ultimate M·A·C hack for achieving your best face routine. Plus, they layer evenly and blend seamlessly with your concealer, foundation or favourite complexion products to provide non-fading and non-caking coverage, along with crease-resistant and waterproof wear. Available in six Artist-approved shades rooted in colour theory to target specific skin concerns with a high-performance formula suitable for all skin types. Key Benefits: •24HR colour-true longwear •Comfortable and lightweight •Customizable, on-the-spot coverage •Natural soft-matte finish •Sweat- and humidity-resistant •Hydrating •Waterproof •Non-fading, non-caking, non-streaking, non-poring •Crease-resistant and settling-resistant •Suitable for all skin types (oily to dry) •Non-acnegenic (does not cause acne or breakouts) •Non-comedogenic (does not clog pores) •Dermatologist-tested Product Usage: •Apply directly to skin using the applicator, fingertips or a 270S Brush. •Blend and build to desired level of coverage.

page_json.name: MAC Skinfinish Sunstruck Bronzer| 24HR Bronzing Powder, Matte + Radiant Finishes, Buildable/Blendable
page_json.description: A 24HR bronzing powder that provides buildable, colour-true coverage in matte and radiant finishes.   New look. Same 24HR bronzing powder. Warm up skin with sun-real colour using our best-selling bronzer – now in a sleek chrome compact with a M·A·C-embossed design. Create believable warmth all year long using our best-selling bronzing powder in [15] colour-true, Artist-crafted shades. Available in soft-matte and dimensional radiant finishes, this buildable and blendable formula is infused with our Marshmallow Cushion Blend to deliver silky-smooth texture and skin adherence. This high-performance waterproof and sweat- and humidity-resistant formula provides 24-hour buildable coverage. Pair with our all-new 143S Bronzer Fan Brush to effortlessly shade your complexion with Pro-level precision. Extend that summer feeling all year long with our Artists’ best-kept secret for sun-kissed warmth.Key Claims & Benefits•Stays colour-true, 24 hours •Non-fading, 24 hours•Non-settling and non-creasing, 12 hours •Waterproof•Sweat- and humidity-resistant•Does not cause acne •Dermatologist-tested •For all skin typesHow to Use•Apply onto face or body with a 143S Bronzer Fan Brush for natural-looking warmth and sun-kissed colour. •Blend or build to desired coverage and look.

product.highlights:
• Type: Eye shadow
  • Format: Travel size eye shadow, 1.5gm
  • A saturated pressed powder eye shadow in four textures featuring even more pigment-packed payoff

Our iconic Eye Shadow formula is now drenched with even more colour in a variety of textures and finishes. Soft, silky and velvety to the touch, this state-of-the-art formula features all-new Pigment Expression Technology, which provides extreme colour payoff in a single swipe with super-smooth dispersion. Create a customized palette of shades by fitting into any Pro Palette Eye Shadow / Concealer Insert for easy storage and transport. Reindulge in your favourite colour icon: M∙A∙C Eye Shadow   Key Claims & Benefits •Rich colour payoff in a single swipe •Soft, silky texture•Smooth, even pigment  •Easily blendable•Use wet or dry •Dermatologist tested •Ophthalmologist tested •Non-acnegenic •Safe for contact lens wearers   Product Usage •Sweep colour across eyes using your favourite M∙A∙C eye brush. •For even more opacity, dip a 239S Brush into Eye Shadow, spritz with Prep + Prime Fix+ and press onto lids. •Create your own custom liner by loading a 263S Brush with Eye Shadow, spritzing with Prep + Prime Fix+ and painting the wet colour on the upper or lower lash lines.

128486329.title: MAC Studio Fix Powder Plus Foundation/ Matte Finish 24 HR Oil-Control (35 Shades) Best Seller
128486329.detail_text: Get into an ALL-NEW formula and NEW shades from the #1 powder foundation brand* - with a formula made for every shade of you. Our iconic Studio Fix Powder Plus Foundation - a two-in-one foundation and setting powder - gets reimagined with a blur-matte finish and 24-hour oil control. The lightweight, blendable formula includes rose, sugar kelp and red algae extracts. The silky talc-free texture smooths and evens skin tone and delivers customizable medium-to-full coverage while also being sweat- and humidity-resistant. This breathable powder and foundation is available in 78 shades for all and does not look grey on any skin tone - all houses in refillable packaging.

product.desc: Get into an ALL-NEW formula and NEW shades from the #1 powder foundation brand* - with a formula made for every shade of you. Our iconic Studio Fix Powder Plus Foundation - a two-in-one foundation and setting powder - gets reimagined with a blur-matte finish and 24-hour oil control. The lightweight, blendable formula includes rose, sugar kelp and red algae extracts. The silky talc-free texture smooths and evens skin tone and delivers customizable medium-to-full coverage while also being sweat- and humidity-resistant. This breathable powder and foundation is available in 78 shades for all and does not look grey on any skin tone - all houses in refillable packaging.

page_json.description: MAC Lipglazer Glossy Liner offers creamy, high-pigmentation coverage for volumizing and filling lips. This versatile, non-waterproof liner provides effortless application and endless styling options for a fuller, more defined lip look. - Lazada

13706643624.title: MAC Lipglass Cushion High-Pigment Lip Oil | 72HR Hydrating, Cushiony Barrier
13706643624.detail_text: Quit compromising on colour when your lips crave hydration. This high-pigment, high-shine lip oil delivers intense colour payoff while also providing 72HR hydration in a cushiony, comfortable formula that improves the moisture barrier of lips. Rich with vivid saturation, this innovation paints lips with high-impact colour and polishes lips with shine. Plus, this transformative gel-to-oil is infused with sweet almond oil to soften and smooth, drenching lips with care - and colour. The pigment of a lipstick. The shine of a gloss. The cushiony care of an oil. Your lips can have it all. Quit compromising on colour when your lips crave hydration. This high-pigment, high-shine lip oil delivers intense colour payoff while also providing 72HR hydration in a cushiony, comfortable formula that improves the moisture barrier of lips. Rich with vivid saturation, this innovation paints lips with high-impact colour and polishes lips with shine. Plus, this transformative gel-to-oil is infused with sweet almond oil to soften and smooth, drenching lips with care - and colour. The pigment of a lipstick. The shine of a gloss. The cushiony care of

an oil. Your lips can have it all.

Boy Bait: Light peach nude

Malt: Neutral brown beige

Tantrum: Bright red

Yes!: Warm orange

Dressed To Dazzle: Taupe lilac with iridescent pearl

Grapesicle: Deep berry

Key Claims and Benefits

• 72HR hydration

• Improves moisture barrier of lips

• Soothes with moisture

• High pigment, high shine

• Cushiony, comfortable formula

3190096477.title: 【MINI】 MAC Macximal Sleek Satin Lipstick sleek satin finish 8HR hydration pigment rich colour
3190096477.detail_text: What is it: Miniature size. M·A·Cximal impact. Our signature Satin Lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a sleek, satin finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels better and hydrates lips for eight whole hours. Get MORE COMFORT with full-coverage, pigment-rish payoff in [six] iconic shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a balmy blend of good-for-lips ingredients, including pomegranate flower extract to hydrate lips and camellia seed and rosehips oils to condition. Get MORE SLEEK with this undupeable lineup of meticulously crafted colours that provides a pristinely polished look on lips. Get MORE CHIC with this multiuse formula that serves up a seamless, monochromatic gleam on cheeks. And finally, get MORE CONVENIENT with a miniature size made for on the go. These maxed-out minis still serve up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will). Benefits: •8 hours of comfort and hydration •Hydrates lips with pomegranate flower extract •Conditions lips with camellia seed and rosehip oils •Full-coverage, pigment-rich colour •Works on lips and cheeks •Lips look visibly fuller and more defined •Plumps lips via moisturization •Visibly reduces the appearance of fine, dry lines •Signature vanilla scent •Lipstick case features PCR material Application: •Create a smooth canvas for colour with Prep + Prime Lip. •Apply Lipstick directly to lips. •Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish. •Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour. •Pro tip: Apply to the centre of lips and blend out using a 318S Brush to create a blurred effect. Removal: •Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips. •Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

product.desc:
What is it:

Miniature size. M·A·Cximal impact. Our signature Satin Lipstick has been maxed out to give lips MORE with a sleek, satin finish and good-for-lips formula that looks richer, feels better and hydrates lips for eight whole hours. Get MORE COMFORT with full-coverage, pigment-rish payoff in [six] iconic shades. Get MORE COMFORT with a balmy blend of good-for-lips ingredients, including pomegranate flower extract to hydrate lips and camellia seed and rosehips oils to condition. Get MORE SLEEK with this undupeable lineup of meticulously crafted colours that provides a pristinely polished look on lips. Get MORE CHIC with this multiuse formula that serves up a seamless, monochromatic gleam on cheeks. And finally, get MORE CONVENIENT with a miniature size made for on the go. These maxed-out minis still serve up that signature vanilla scent you already love (or soon will).

Benefits:

•8 hours of comfort and hydration

•Hydrates lips with pomegranate flower extract

•Conditions lips with camellia seed and rosehip oils

•Full-coverage, pigment-rich colour

•Works on lips and cheeks

•Lips look visibly fuller and more defined

•Plumps lips via moisturization

•Visibly reduces the appearance of fine, dry lines

•Signature vanilla scent

•Lipstick case features PCR material

Application:

•Create a smooth canvas for colour with Prep + Prime Lip.

•Apply Lipstick directly to lips.

•Pro tip: Define lips with Lip Pencil or layer on Lipglass for a high-shine finish.

•Pro tip: Dab Lipstick on cheeks for a monochomatic pop of colour.

•Pro tip: Apply to the centre of lips and blend out using a 318S Brush to create a blurred effect.

Removal:

•Dispense one to two pumps of Hyper Real™ Fresh Canvas Cleansing Oil into the palm of your hand and gently massage onto lips.

•Emulsify with warm water, rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

product.desc: Colour: locked. Comfort: loaded. Slip into 24 hours of rich matte colour with our kissproof and transfer-resistant lipstick. Featuring an ultra-precise slim stick, our longest-wearing lipstick to date effortlessly douses lips with a full-coverage, ultra-creamy matte finish. Our exclusive FlexiLock Technology delivers long-wearing, flexible coverage for softer, smoother lips. This good-for-lips formula comes nutrient-packed with conditioning passion fruit oil for a comfortable, next-to-naked feel. No skipping, no dragging – and no touch-ups needed. Just twist up and glide to apply, then recap until you hear a click once your look is locked.
product.highlights: A kissproof and transfer-resistant lipstick with 24 hours of wear and rich matte colour.

page_json.description: M·A·C Canada. A kissproof and transfer-resistant lipstick with 24 hours of wear and rich matte colour. Colour: locked. Comfort: loaded. Slip into 24 hours of rich matte colour with our kissproof and transfer-resistant lipstick. Featuring an ultra-precise slim stick, our longest-wearing lipstick to date effortlessly douses lips with a full-coverage, ultra-creamy matte finish. Our exclusive FlexiLock Technology delivers long-wearing, flexible coverage for softer, smoother lips. This good-for-lips formula comes nutrient-packed with conditioning passion fruit oil for a comfortable, next-to-naked feel. No skipping, no dragging and no touch-ups needed. Just twist up and glide to apply, then recap until you hear a click once your look is locked

712230047.detail_text: What is it: Discover the runway-inspired Strobe formula that started it all as our ultimate quick fix for skin. This versatile illuminating moisturizer comes available in shades that replicate daylight to candlelight, and can be worn alone, under foundation or as a highlighter that works all over. It provides all-day moisture and iridescence for luminous, healthy-looking skin. Our best-selling formula includes hyaluronic acid to increase hydration, plus a Barrier-Boosting Blend featuring ceramides and Iridescent Crystal Pearls to amplify radiance without glitter or shimmer.
